title: Wonderful Dubai Getaway with Cruise
shortDescription: Combine four nights in Dubai with two nights at sea aboard Resorts World One. In the city you'll enjoy a half-day tour, a desert safari with dinner and a Marina dhow cruise.
description: Combine four nights in Dubai with two nights at sea aboard Resorts World One. In the city you'll enjoy a half-day tour, a desert safari with dinner and a Marina dhow cruise.
Then step on board for two nights of ocean views, entertainment and all meals included on the cruise — a relaxed way to add a sea voyage to your Dubai holiday.

inclusions: 2 Nights Stay on Resorts World Cruises- Resorts World One (Interior Stateroom)
4 Buffet Breakfast at Hotel & All Meals on Cruise (Kindly check the Timings & Venue from the Hotel)
All tours & transfers on Seat in Coach (Shared) basis
exclusions: Passenger travelling to Dubai must carry at least 2000 AED (per person) or equivalent US $ with Bill
Medical Travel Insurance (Note: It is Mandatory for all the Passengers)
Any service not mentioned in the inclusions
Tourism Dirham (hotel tax) to be paid by the guest directly at hotel at the time of Checkout
Gratuity fees: USD 20 (per person / per night) to be paid on board Cruise directly
TCS* 5% will be applicable on the total package cost
Tax Collected at Source is the tax payable by a seller which he collects from the buyer at the time of sale
With a view to widen the tax-net, the Indian Govt. (vide the Finance Act, 2020) has extended the scope of Tax Collected at Source (“TCS”) provided under Section 206C of the Income-tax Act, 1961
